display_information.name: GSD HR Bot
display_information.description: Automates employee onboarding and offboarding - GSD Outsources
display_information.long_description: GSD HR Bot is a comprehensive solution designed to manage the entire employee lifecycle within your organization. It automatically provisions essential tools including Google Workspace, Slack, Time Doctor, HubSpot, and GitHub, ensuring a seamless experience for new hires. By using simple commands like /onboard for new employees and /offboard for exits, HR teams can eliminate manual tasks, reduce human error, and ensure all security protocols are followed when revoking access. This bot centralizes your people operations directly within Slack, fostering a culture of efficiency and organized execution for all team transitions.

slash_commands.description: Start onboarding process for a new employee
Start offboarding process for an exiting employee
Check status of all active HR processes
IT: send a password reset request to an employee
